subject: aftd
title: AF.TD.------MT.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-7. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'creative music have already established a significant momentum — with respect to how its affinity dynamics have determined the present course western culture is now pursuing — and as such, this continuum is in an excellent position to accelerate the fundamentals of the next time cycle.' The crossing diagrams how affinity-tendencies structurally meets multi-information: AFTD (affinity tendencies) crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). AFTD sits at left with the subject-arrow; PRI-INFO (principle information) at upper-center and ATTN (attraction) with VT-PLT (vibrational platform) at upper-right on the upper branch. (P)UTZ (the point of idea completion of utilization) sits at upper-left. T-L (time lag) sits centrally, hanging from the VT-PLT line, and (R)P-FC (the reality of particular focus) at center-right on its own branch from the main line. SPT-D at the left-center and (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) below as the subject's downward chain. PER-DY (perception dynamics) and MT-INFO at right-bottom anchor the partner-axis terminus. Structural argument: when affinity-tendencies is crossed with multi-information, the upper branch runs from the main line to ATTN; PRI-INFO branches from the ATTN line, with (P)UTZ branching from the PRI-INFO line, and VT-PLT branches from the ATTN line, with T-L branching from the VT-PLT line. SPT-D → (R)INTR is the subject's downward chain — SPT-D routes through the reality of interpretation. (R)P-FC → PER-DY → MT-INFO branches from the main line: the reality of particular-focus routes through perception-dynamics into multi-information.
